claims.claim_ar: انتقال الخطاب من مخاطب مخصوص (بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ) إلى عموم/مبهم (وَمَنْ) — إلتفات بلاغي يوسّع الحكم من خاصة إلى عامة ويشدد التحذير.
claims.claim_en: A shift of address (iltifat): the verse begins addressing a specific addressee (Bani Isra'il) and then shifts to a general/indefinite subject ('and whoever...'), broadening the scope and strengthening the warning.

claims.claim_ar: الربط الشرطي بين استبدال النِعْمَة والعقاب (وَمَنْ يُبَدِّلْ نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ ... فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ) يعمل كأسلوب فصل ووصل: بيان السبب والنتيجة كتحذير وعقاب محقّق.
claims.claim_en: Fasl-wasl (separation/connection): the conditional link between changing God's favor and the punitive result ('and whoever changes the favor of Allah ... then indeed Allah is severe in punishment') functions to connect cause and consequence as a stern warning.
claims.needs_review_reason: The provided chunk discusses the favour given to their fathers ('ما أنعم به على آبائهم') but does not quote the exact conditional sentence; the conditional linkage is inferred from the ayah rather than an explicit chunk quotation.
